_comment: DS §15 — this repo's declaration of what the XSS rule covers.
Product source only: code that runs for a user.
Both files were extracted from index.html's inline <script> on 2026-09-07
(#21), which is what made them lint-reachable at all. app.js assigns
decoded certificate data to innerHTML (line ~200) and pretty-prints
JSON/NDJSON payloads with JSON.stringify; cert-core.js is the DOM-free
ASN.1/X.509 parser it consumes. Neither currently interpolates
JSON.stringify into a template literal — 0 findings today — but both are
the genuine, reachable product source, and app.js in particular is
exactly where the hazard this rule exists for would land.
